messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: Call your doctor at once if you have:
signs of a high potassium level (hyperkalemia), such as muscle weakness or a heavy feeling in your legs, a slow or uneven heartbeat, numbness or tingling in your hands, feet, or lips, nausea, or feeling restless and on edge;
a light-headed feeling like you might pass out, which can be a sign you have low blood pressure (hypotension)
little or no urination, or swelling in your ankles, hands, or feet, which can be signs your kidneys are struggling (worsening renal function);
signs of a low sodium level, such as confusion, severe weakness, muscle pain or cramps, feeling unsteady, or slurred speech;
severe or ongoing vomiting or diarrhea, since losing too much fluid and salt can send your blood pressure and kidney function the wrong way;
A skin rash spreads.
A skin rash blisters.
Skin peels.
Sores form in your mouth.
A rash appears with a fever.
Glands swell.
These symptoms can be signs of a rare but serious skin reaction.
yellowing of your eyes or skin, dark urine, or pain in your upper stomach, which can be signs of a liver problem;
Triplet: ["Spironolactone", "has symptom of serious side effect", "slurred speech"]

The relation 'has symptom of serious side effect' in the triplet is defined as 'An occurrence of the symptom specified by the object entity may indicate the serious adverse effect caused by the subject drug.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'has side effect': The subject drug may cause the adverse effect or symptom specified by the object entity.
B. 'has side effect frequency': The subject drug may cause the adverse effect specified by the object entity with the frequency indicated.
C. 'has serious side effect': The subject drug may cause the serious or potentially dangerous adverse effect specified by the object entity that requires medical attention.
D. 'has overdose symptom': An overdose of the subject drug may cause the symptom specified by the object entity.
E. 'may worsen': The subject drug may cause the medical condition specified by the object entity to become more severe.
F. None of the above.

Answer:
